IncidentBot: INCIDENT CREATED · High error rate + memory pressure on inference fleet for embeddings routes (/v1/embeddings). Pager triggered for oncall.
Alex: Paging @Pria — seeing sudden embeddings QPS jump ~7k -> 18k, pods OOMing, some rerank timeouts. Starting live mitigation. 4760001240
Priya: Oncall Priya here, I'm looking. Can you paste top routes and any noisy customer ids? 4760001245
Alex: Top hot route: embeds-prod-us-east (/v1/embeddings) traffic from partner 'textify'. Rerank route also seeing latency increases. No immediate data exfil. 4760001250
Alex: Proposal: carve QPS from embeds-prod to soft-limit and disable rerank on public routes temporarily to reduce pressure. Also enable aggressive batching/cooldown on embed hot route. 4760001255
Priya: Agree. Plan: (1) set per-endpoint qps for /v1/embeddings -> 2500 (was 7000) for public routes, keep dedicated customers unaffected; (2) set rerank_public.allowed = false; (3) enable KV-cache ttl bump for embeddings. Applying now. 4760001262
Priya: Runbook snippet I'm using:
```
# set quota
POST https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/quota
{"route":"/v1/embeddings","scope":"public","qps":2500}
# disable rerank
POST https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/routes/rerank_public
{"allowed":false}
```
